limitations.limitation: The external world is a simulation, not the real remote.
limitations.mitigation: The one property the matrix depends on, that republishing an identical tree converges on one commit, is checked against real git plumbing in R3 and tests/test_git_custody_probe.py. Nothing else about the remote is asserted.
limitations.residual_risk: Real remotes can fail in ways this world does not model: partial packs, ref races between two writers, server-side hooks, quota refusals.

limitations.limitation: Faults are injected at declared boundaries, not at arbitrary instruction points.
limitations.mitigation: The boundaries are chosen where the bytes on disk actually differ before and after, and every deliberately excluded (transition, fault) pair is enumerated with a reason rather than silently omitted.
limitations.residual_risk: A durability boundary nobody named cannot be faulted.

limitations.limitation: The simulation is single-threaded, so no true concurrency is exercised.
limitations.mitigation: Ownership transfer is modelled explicitly through fence tokens and lease expiry, which is the concurrency hazard the commission's custody rules address.
limitations.residual_risk: Interleavings that require two workers to be genuinely simultaneous are out of scope. Determinism was chosen over concurrency deliberately: an unrepeatable failing run cannot be used as evidence.

limitations.limitation: The fuzz campaign is 2000 seeded cases with up to 4 overlapping faults, which is not exhaustive over multi-fault schedules.
limitations.mitigation: The exhaustive single-fault matrix is complete over its declared vocabulary.
limitations.residual_risk: The M6 rejection says only that this campaign found no safety class the matrix missed at this model's size. A larger campaign or a larger model could invert it, which is why the comparison is a standing test rather than a conclusion.

detail.reason: The PDF was retrieved and hashed, but no PDF text extractor is available in this runtime (pdftotext absent, no third-party packages permitted), so no claim is asserted from it.
The abstract page returned an interstitial challenge rather than content.
Intended as a lineage-driven fault injection source; the URL no longer resolves to the paper, so no lineage-driven claim is asserted anywhere in this unit.

limitations.limitation: Three external sources could not be read in this runtime.
limitations.mitigation: They are recorded as NOT_SUPPORTED and no hypothesis cites them; tests/test_reproductions.py asserts that separation.
limitations.residual_risk: Any argument those sources would have supported is simply absent.

limitations.limitation: M1 and M2 are proposals, not applied changes: the seeded validator and the input generator are read-only to this unit.
limitations.mitigation: Both arrive with a working implementation in this subtree and a paired recurrence test, so the coordinator can evaluate them against evidence rather than a description.
limitations.residual_risk: Until a coordinator acts, the repository gate is still the unstrengthened seeded validator, and all 64 frozen Wave A inputs still cannot resolve their own minimum_protocol_ancestor.

limitations.detail: .github/workflows/po03-contracts.yml runs unittest discovery rooted at workstreams/po03/tests, so this unit's 251 tests are not executed by CI as configured. The workflow is read-only to this unit.
limitations.limitation: The seeded workflow does not discover tests in a unit subtree.
limitations.mitigation: The command and its full output are recorded in evidence/test-run.txt.
limitations.residual_risk: Without a coordinator change, these tests will not gate future commits.

limitations.limitation: The read-back verification in ready-to-commit.json is performed by this producer, from a fresh clone of the immutable remote commit.
limitations.mitigation: It reads from the pushed commit rather than the working tree, through a clone that shares no objects with the producer's worktree, and reports each artifact's digest and byte count.
limitations.residual_risk: A producer verifying its own return is not independent acceptance. That remains NOT_TESTED and is the coordinator's to perform.

limitations.limitation: The canary fixture's originating commit may not be present in every clone.
limitations.mitigation: The bytes and digest are embedded, and git_custody_probe.verify_recorded_canary reports NOT_SUPPORTED rather than guessing when the object is absent.
limitations.residual_risk: In such a clone the fixture's provenance rests on the recorded digest alone.

not_supported.question: Does the production PO-03 dispatch path survive these faults?
not_supported.reason: This unit builds and tests a harness and a reference custody machine. It does not instrument the live dispatcher, and no claim is made about it.

not_supported.question: Was the recorded PO-02 Code-2 loss caused by the mechanism this unit models?
not_supported.reason: R1 reproduces the recorded outcome, a provider completion with no durable commit classified as PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED, on a sanitized workload. Reproducing an outcome is not establishing the original cause, and no post-hoc cause is claimed.

not_supported.question: Would multi-fault fuzzing outperform exhaustive enumeration on a larger model?
not_supported.reason: Measured only at this model's size; nothing is asserted beyond it.

scope_of_the_claim: The SUPPORTED verdict is about this custody model under this fault vocabulary, in a deterministic single-process simulation. It is not a claim about the production dispatch path, which this unit does not execute.
